Questions.content: What is the reasoning behind assuming the domain of \(\log x^2\) is \(x < a\) or \(x > b\)? This assumption might not cover all cases, as the function is also defined for \(x = -a\) and \(x = a\). Consider revising the task to find the correct domain first.
